intro: The Luna coffee table brings graceful curves, elegant marble finish, and practical storage together to create a warm, inviting space for you and your loved ones.

features.title: Marble finish for an elegant touch
features.text: Make a statement with a high-gloss marble finish that transforms any room into a sleek, modern retreat.

features.title: Gentle curves for comfort and style
features.text: Smooth arcs seamlessly connect tabletop and base, adding elegance while softening the look of your space.

features.title: Roomy shelf for daily essentials
features.text: Luna coffee table combines clever storage with elegant design. Its hidden compartment keeps everyday items out of sight, helping you maintain a tidy, organised living space.

features.title: Scratch-resistant top stays pristine
features.text: Daily life is no match for our tough build, designed to handle constant use without compromising on quality or looks.

features.title: Timeless warmth with teak finish
features.text: Whatever your style—modern minimalism or classic charm—our warm wood finish complements your décor beautifully, blending effortlessly into your home’s personality.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
